details:
Q1. Which part of this repository should be improved? (Choose one primary target; use A+C only if it genuinely spans both.)
Choices:
A. Clarify/plan pipeline (`clarify.yml`, `plan.yml`, related prompts/scripts)
B. Implement/review pipeline (`implement.yml`, `review_autofix.yml`, related prompts/scripts)
C. Orchestrate/validate/runtime workflows (`orchestrate*.yml`, `validate.yml`, related scripts)
D. Docs/tests/reference only
E. Other — name the exact workflow, script, file, or feature to improve (RECOMMENDED)
Q2. What kind of improvement do you want in that area?
Choices:
A. Fix a specific bug or regression
B. Reduce runtime, cost, or flakiness
C. Add or change behavior
D. Improve docs, observability, or operator UX
E. Other — state the exact desired result in 1 sentence (RECOMMENDED)
Q3. What should count as “done” for this issue?
Choices:
A. A named failing workflow/check/run should pass — include the workflow/check name or a run/PR link
B. A specific before/after behavior should change — describe the current behavior and desired behavior (RECOMMENDED)
C. Specific docs/tests/contracts should be updated — name the files or sections if known
D. Other — give the concrete acceptance criteria you want
